description: From the supplied seamless invitation pattern tile, derive the web assets the treatment needs: (a) a muted single-color forest/sage duotone tile at near-watermark contrast against the cream background, recolored toward Theme token values, for use as the page wall; (b) optimized full-color motif assets (fig, foliage, Golden Gate) for text-free accent zones. The source tile's faint left/right seam is blended if visible at display treatment; the top/bottom wrap is already clean. Outputs are web-optimized (small, retina-crisp at the chosen display scale).
title: Pattern assets derived: muted duotone wall tile and full-color accents
acceptance_criteria: A duotone wall tile exists whose color reads as near-watermark against the cream background and derives from Theme token values
Full-color accent assets exist for text-free zones, web-optimized
Tiled at display scale, no visible seam on either axis
The supplied source tile is preserved untouched under source material
